limitations: Release lists were bounded to the first three entries for Indonesian repositories; drafts were excluded and no unpublished draft metadata is included.
Source/backend assets are identified from API digests or pinned publisher checksum text, not bulk-downloaded, extracted or rehashed here.
Canonical English repositories were checked by default-branch commit; their release feeds were not exhaustively inventoried.
The B10 English compare response reached the 300-file API limit; full changed-file coverage is not claimed.
AX and MV/SB assignments remain catalog/crosswalk responsibilities; this baseline does not invent separate upstream repository mappings.
Method and capability counts are producer-reported facts from selected committed text/JSON, not independently rerun backend or learning-quality validations.
No worker adoption, browser route validation, mathematical source audit or full remote-state completeness is implied.
